corpus.title: Push notifications stopped after updating the Android app
corpus.problem: Since the v2.1 update nobody on Android receives rent reminders or message notifications. Reinstalling brings them back for some users.
corpus.resolution: The update changed the Firebase sender config so FCM issued new tokens, but the app only registered its token at first login. Now re-registers on every launch and on token refresh.

corpus.title: Tenants stuck in a login loop after resetting their password
corpus.problem: After resetting the password from the email link, the app shows the home screen for a second and returns to the login screen, over and over.
corpus.resolution: Password reset revokes refresh tokens but the app kept retrying with the old one. Clear stored tokens on login and treat a revoked refresh token as sign-out.

corpus.title: Rent reminders sent twice
corpus.problem: Every tenant received two identical rent reminders a few seconds apart for three days in a row.
corpus.resolution: Two API instances both ran the reminder cron. Added an advisory lock and a unique key per tenant per day.

corpus.title: App freezes when opening a long chat
corpus.problem: Opening a conversation with hundreds of messages freezes the app for 10-20 seconds on older Android phones.
corpus.resolution: Chat rendered the full history in a ScrollView. Switched to a paginated FlatList loading 50 messages at a time.

corpus.title: Monthly payout report doesn't match the bank statement
corpus.problem: The payout report total is higher than what the bank received; payments on the last evening of the month land in the wrong month.
corpus.resolution: Month boundaries were computed in UTC instead of Asia/Colombo. Report now uses the account timezone.

corpus.title: Lease PDF download shows Access Denied after leaving the page open
corpus.problem: If the lease page stays open for a while, Download PDF shows an XML AccessDenied error. Refreshing fixes it.
corpus.resolution: The presigned S3 URL expired after 15 minutes. The button now fetches a fresh presigned URL on click.

corpus.title: Card payments stay pending although the bank charged the tenant
corpus.problem: Tenants' banks show the card charge but the portal lists the payment as pending for days.
corpus.resolution: The gateway rotated its webhook signing secret and all callbacks failed with 401. Updated the secret, replayed webhooks, added alerting.

corpus.title: Property photo upload fails silently for large images
corpus.problem: Landlords uploading photos over 5 MB see the progress bar complete but the image never appears.
corpus.resolution: Files above the multipart threshold fell through. Fixed the upload handler and added client-side compression.

corpus.title: Bulk tenant CSV import creates duplicate tenants
corpus.problem: Re-running a tenant import after a timeout duplicated every tenant and their leases.
corpus.resolution: Import now upserts on national ID and unit, inside one transaction, and duplicates were merged.

corpus.title: Landlords logged out every few minutes
corpus.problem: Landlords are signed out every 3-5 minutes while working in the portal, losing unsaved forms.
corpus.resolution: Session cookie max-age was set in seconds where milliseconds were expected. Fixed and added a test.

corpus.title: Wrong currency symbol on INR listings
corpus.problem: Listings priced in rupees show the LKR symbol.
corpus.resolution: Currency formatter fell back to the default locale. Patched the formatter.

corpus.title: Invoice emails stopped being sent
corpus.problem: Tenants stopped receiving invoice emails although invoices are created.
corpus.resolution: The email provider API key expired. Rotated the key and added a failed-send alert.

corpus.title: Two-factor codes rejected for some users
corpus.problem: About a third of lawyers can't log in because authenticator codes are rejected, though typed correctly.
corpus.resolution: One auth server's clock drifted 70 seconds after NTP was blocked. Restored NTP and added drift monitoring.

corpus.title: Court deadline reminders emailed a day late
corpus.problem: Filing deadline reminders arrive on the deadline day instead of the day before.
corpus.resolution: Reminder job ran at 00:00 UTC and picked 'tomorrow' in UTC. Now hourly, using each firm's timezone.

corpus.title: Large scanned contracts time out on upload
corpus.problem: Scanned contracts over about 20 MB fail with a timeout after a minute.
corpus.resolution: Uploads went through the API with a 60 s proxy timeout. Switched to direct presigned multipart uploads to S3.

corpus.title: Case search takes over 30 seconds
corpus.problem: Searching cases by party name became very slow after importing 40,000 archived cases.
corpus.resolution: ILIKE search had no usable index. Added a pg_trgm GIN index; 32 s down to 80 ms.

corpus.title: Shared documents visible to the wrong case party
corpus.problem: A document shared with opposing counsel in one case appeared in another case's shared folder.
corpus.resolution: Share links were cached by folder name. Cache key now includes the case ID.

corpus.title: Korean text turns into question marks in Word export
corpus.problem: Exporting briefs to Word replaces Korean characters with question marks.
corpus.resolution: The DOCX writer used a Latin-only default font. Embedded a CJK font and set the East Asian font attribute.

corpus.title: Billing report double-counts split time entries
corpus.problem: Split time entries are counted in full on both cases in the billing report.
corpus.resolution: Report summed entry hours instead of allocation hours. Fixed the query and regenerated affected reports.

corpus.title: Invitation emails never arrive for new users
corpus.problem: Newly invited users never receive the invitation email; resending doesn't help.
corpus.resolution: Invitation emails were sent from an unverified sender domain and dropped. Verified the domain with SPF and DKIM.

corpus.title: Password reset link says expired immediately
corpus.problem: Users clicking a fresh password reset link get 'Link expired'.
corpus.resolution: Email security scanners opened the link first and consumed the one-time token. Token is now consumed on form submit, not on page view.

corpus.title: Hearing times off by one hour after the clocks changed
corpus.problem: After daylight saving ended, hearings show one hour later for New York cases.
corpus.resolution: Hearing times were stored as local time without a zone. Migrated to timestamptz with the case's timezone.

corpus.title: E-signature widget won't load in Safari
corpus.problem: The e-signature panel stays blank in Safari 17.
corpus.resolution: Safari blocked the third-party iframe cookies. Moved signing to a first-party subdomain.

corpus.title: Session expires while drafting long documents
corpus.problem: Lawyers drafting for over an hour lose their work when the session expires.
corpus.resolution: Added sliding session renewal while the editor is active and autosave every 30 seconds.

corpus.title: Alignment jobs run out of memory on large FASTQ files
corpus.problem: Alignment fails with Killed (exit code 137) for samples above about 40 GB.
corpus.resolution: OOM killer. Stream reads in 5M-read chunks, samtools sort -m 2G, higher memory limit for large samples.

corpus.title: Duplicate samples after re-running ingestion
corpus.problem: Re-running ingestion for a plate after a network error duplicated every sample on it.
corpus.resolution: Added a unique constraint on plate and barcode and made ingestion an upsert.

corpus.title: Nightly pipeline did not start after daylight saving change
corpus.problem: The nightly batch never started on the night the clocks changed, with no errors.
corpus.resolution: Scheduler used local time and the slot was skipped. Moved all schedules to UTC.

corpus.title: SSO login fails for emails with a plus sign
corpus.problem: Users with a + in their email get 'User not found' after SSO sign-in.
corpus.resolution: The SAML callback read the email from an undecoded query string. Now read from the signed assertion.

corpus.title: PDF export cuts off wide tables
corpus.problem: Exported PDFs cut off tables with more than 8 columns.
corpus.resolution: Wide tables switch to landscape and split across pages with the ID column repeated.

corpus.title: Pipeline jobs stuck in queue after a compute node failure
corpus.problem: Jobs stayed queued for hours after one compute node died.
corpus.resolution: The scheduler kept assigning jobs to the dead node. Added node health checks and automatic requeue.

corpus.title: Gzipped FASTQ files over 2 GB fail to parse
corpus.problem: The parser fails on .fastq.gz files larger than 2 GB.
corpus.resolution: A 32-bit offset overflowed. Switched to streaming decompression with 64-bit offsets.

corpus.title: Charts blank on Safari mobile
corpus.problem: Variant frequency charts don't render on Safari on iOS.
corpus.resolution: Canvas renderer was blocked; switched charts to SVG on mobile breakpoints.

corpus.title: Excel export missing header row
corpus.problem: Excel exports of the variant table have data but no column headers.
corpus.resolution: The xlsx writer skipped headers when column keys were numeric. Fixed in v2.5.1.

corpus.title: VCF export truncates INFO field for multi-allelic variants
corpus.problem: INFO values are cut off for variants with more than one alternate allele.
corpus.resolution: The writer used a fixed-length buffer. Switched to dynamic allocation.

corpus.title: Dashboard empty after server timezone change
corpus.problem: After switching the server timezone to IST, today's data disappeared from the dashboard.
corpus.resolution: Today's range was computed in server local time but compared with UTC. Normalised to UTC.

corpus.title: Job completion emails not sent
corpus.problem: No completion emails arrive when pipeline jobs finish.
corpus.resolution: The notification worker crashed on a malformed address and stopped. Added validation and a supervisor restart.
